terminus-font's Makefile converts the bdf fonts with bdftopcf (x/x11 util, not named in the SlackBuild)

tree-sitter: "cargo fetch" downloads the crates over https on every build; the vendored tarball is not enough (wasmtime-c-api-impl in vendor/ is a filtered stub, but the SlackBuild builds --all-features with wasm). sfs-seeds.sh fetches them on the host (seeds/cargo-home, used offline by overrides/all/tree-sitter); without it the build needs network + certs.
valadoc links graphviz (pass-1 override builds vala without valadoc)
vte meson: dependency('fast_float') (header-only C++; without it meson tries to git clone the subproject)
vulkan-sdk's gfxreconstruct includes <xcb/xcb_keysyms.h>; it loads the library with dlopen (xcb_keysyms_loader), so no ELF edge shows it.
wayland-protocols' meson.build needs wayland-scanner (dependency(), no fallback without a subprojects dir)
zxing-cpp -DZXING_UNIT_TESTS=ON: zxing.cmake takes GTest from the system and otherwise git clones googletest (FetchContent; offline it fails).  Pat has d/googletest installed.
zxing-cpp's system-stb.patch makes cmake use stb::stb from /usr/include/stb (d/stb, headers only: no ELF edge)
